review_evidence: Reviewed the 16 primary lean-stlc files. They formalize simply typed lambda calculus syntax, typing, reduction, substitutions and strong-normalization arguments.

A complete source scan found 121 theorem/lemma/axiom/example declarations and 240 declaration-style items overall; representative results include reduction preservation, context renaming and the fundamental theorem used in strong normalization.
This is an independent metatheory formalization and remains primary prior-art evidence.
summary: Reviewed lean-stlc; its theorem-heavy simply typed lambda-calculus metatheory and strong-normalization development are retained.
